title: Massanutten Rental Watch
about: Short-term rental news for Massanutten owners from public county and association records.

key_findings_last_30_days.title: Covenant proposal unchanged, still no deadline
key_findings_last_30_days.detail: The live proposed changes page matches the October 16 baseline in all twenty-four covenant sections. It still gives no feedback deadline and no adoption or vote process. The feedback form is public, but it requires the owner's name, Massanutten address, and email, so every comment is attributable.

key_findings_last_30_days.title: Board heard a 7 to 10 bedroom short-term rental request
key_findings_last_30_days.detail: The October 14 Board of Supervisors agenda includes a special use permit for South Fork Services LLC to convert a barn on a 48-acre agricultural parcel into a second dwelling with seven to ten bedrooms and ten bathrooms, intended as a short-term rental. Staff noted a county short-term rental permit would also be required. The outcome is not posted yet; the minutes will show the vote and any conditions.

key_findings_last_30_days.title: Firewise meeting held October 13
key_findings_last_30_days.detail: The association's calendar shows a Firewise (wildfire safety) meeting on October 13. Wildfire risk is the likely reason for the Covenant 1 rewrite, which would ban all outdoor fires without the association's written approval.

key_findings_last_30_days.title: County updated the short-term rental application form
key_findings_last_30_days.detail: The Short Term Rental Application in the county's document center carries a new date of October 2, 2026. What changed has not been compared yet.

key_findings_last_30_days.title: Board keeps barring short-term rentals in second dwellings
key_findings_last_30_days.detail: At the September 23 meeting, applicants for a second-dwelling permit (SUP26-0903) offered a condition prohibiting short-term rentals. On July 8 the Board added the same condition to another approval by a 4 to 1 vote, at Supervisor Wolfe-Garrison's request.
